findings.text: non-blocking: the case (c) paragraph states the disposition itself landed on the record, but the retained case-c-dispatch-refusal.json records disposition_written: null and after: null with a LedgerError (the scratch store is not a git checkout); the lift is reported only as lifted_after: true with no recorded post-disposition payload, and the fragment's own miss note at line 104 says the commit failed. The required refusal at line 77 is recorded and matches the real review row exactly, so the defect is an overstatement of the extra lift claim, not of the done_when.
